acceptanceRules: Measure each journey separately; do not hide a slow route in aggregate percentiles.
Record offered, started, completed, rejected, failed and timed-out work; client-cap drops count as unmet load.
Baseline and spike must meet budgets. Stress establishes saturation and must preserve correctness and recovery.
Use actual scope-authorized Owner/Operator fixtures; expected denials are separate from throughput traffic.
Keep external payment/message provider latency separate and verify their complete journeys independently.
Run same-Store/same-Book contention separately from a mixed-merchant workload.
Record source/schema/fixture revisions, compute, pooling, sampling, actual device/OS/browser and measured network.
Device classes are minimum reference profiles; pin exact hardware before each run and retain comparability.
Cold database and cold function runs are distinct; verify suspension/restart before crediting cold samples.
Public pre-launch lab evidence does not claim real-user Web Vitals acceptance.
A changed target, load mix or fixture size requires a contract version change and disclosure.
